messages:
Jordan: Rolling canary for merge/5123 showing a p99 spike in eu-west L4 (A10) only. p50 looks fine. Anyone seeing similar?
CI-Bot: perf-e2e/merge-5123 failed: p99 latency > 350ms (baseline ~120ms) in euw2/l4. Full log: https://ci/internal/12345
Maya: Ack. I spun up a repro in euw2 and I see KV cache eviction rate jump and higher prefetch activity. Seems correlated with canary nodes.
Diego: Pasted a quick flame/sample from an A10 L4 replica (short run).
Diego: ```
flamegraph snippet (top stacks):
  kv_cache_lookup 35%
  prefetch_worker 28%
  kernel_selector_fallback 18%
  network_io_wait 10%
  RPC deserialize 6%
```
Anya: Note: PR 5123 modified the kv prefetch window (64 -> 48) and added an alignment tweak intended for H100 vector kernels. That could shift batch boundaries on L4.
Jordan: That would explain region-only impact — H100 path got the intended fix but L4's batching heuristics expect the old alignment.
Maya: Running a git bisect between abc123 (good) and def789 (bad) now. Will try to isolate the commit.
Maya: git bisect start
Maya: git bisect good abc123
Maya: git bisect bad def789
Maya: Bisect result -> bad commit 202a6b4: "runtime: kv prefetch alignment tweak (PR 5123)"
Sam: :eyes: 202a6b4 also touched kernel_selector.cpp lines around fallback heuristics.
Diego: Quick bench numbers (eu-west/l4 - A10 replicas):
Diego: before (pre-5123): p50 12ms, p95 48ms, p99 120ms
Diego: after (post-5123): p50 13ms, p95 55ms, p99 380ms
Diego: QPS roughly identical; network NIC0 queue depth shows short bursts aligning with heavy prefetch windows.
Jordan: Ok — this is a rollout blocker. Requesting immediate revert of 202a6b4 and stop further canaries to euw2/l4 and any other L4 pools.
Deploy-Bot: Rollout blocked for release/merge 5123 by Jordan at 1951236890.
Maya: I reverted 202a6b4 on the release branch and triggered a canary redeploy to euw2/l4.
CI-Bot: perf-e2e/merge-5123 re-run: p50 11ms, p95 44ms, p99 118ms.
Jordan: :thumbsup: Looks back to baseline on the canary. Please hold full rollout until we have a validated fix.
Anya: Follow-up: we need a targeted integration test that exercises prefetched KV patterns with L4 offsets and verifies p99 within threshold. Also update kernel selection conditionals so alignment tweak gates by HW capability, not global flag.
Sam: Created ENG-9876 to track prefetch alignment test + kernel-selection guard. Assigning to eng-runtime.
Jordan: Thanks everyone. Marking the incident as resolved for now; will reopen if we see another regression.
